Inhale Studio — Yoga & Wellness

The original prompt, shown as plain text. Select the text to copy it.

Prompt

Create a calming, elegant homepage for a modern yoga and wellness studio called "Inhale Studio" with two locations in Austin, TX. The design should feel serene, grounded, and inviting — blending warmth with clean minimalism. The studio offers in-person classes, virtual livestreams, and an on-demand video library.

1. NAVIGATION BAR
- Logo: "Inhale" in a refined sans-serif with a small lotus petal accent mark above the "i"
- Links: Classes, Schedule, Instructors, Pricing, On-Demand, Workshops
- Right side: location selector dropdown ("South Lamar" / "Domain"), "Book a Class" CTA (solid #7C6F5B warm taupe)
- White background with subtle bottom border, sticky on scroll
- Mobile: hamburger with full-screen overlay on soft cream background

2. HERO SECTION
- Full-width image of a light-filled studio with warm wood floors, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a practitioner in a graceful warrior pose
- Overlay content (center-aligned):
  - Eyebrow: "Austin's Home for Mindful Movement"
  - Headline: "Breathe. Move. Transform."
  - Subheadline: "Vinyasa, Yin, Hot Yoga, Meditation & more — for every body, every level"
  - Two CTAs: "View Schedule" (solid warm taupe) + "Try Your First Class Free" (outline)
- Subtle warm gradient overlay from bottom (#FDF8F0/80) so text is legible

- Section headline: "Find Your Practice"
- 7 class cards in horizontal scroll:

  - Hot Power Yoga — "Traditional power yoga in 95°F heated room. Deep sweat, deep stretch." — 75 min — Intermediate+ — fire icon
  - Yin Yoga — "Slow, passive poses held 3-5 minutes. Deep connective tissue release." — 75 min — All levels — moon icon
  - Restorative — "Prop-supported poses for total relaxation. Perfect stress relief." — 60 min — All levels — cloud icon
  - Meditation & Breathwork — "Guided mindfulness, pranayama, and visualization techniques." — 30 min — All levels — eye icon
  - Prenatal Yoga — "Safe, nurturing practice for expecting mothers. Modified poses throughout." — 60 min — All levels — heart icon
  - Yoga Sculpt — "Yoga meets light weights. Cardio bursts, strength building, and stretching." — 60 min — Intermediate — dumbbell icon
- Each card: soft rounded corners (16px), pastel accent color strip at top (each class a different muted tone), hover reveals "Book This Class" link
- Background: #FDF8F0 (warm cream)

Design: Warm, serene, organic. Primary: #7C6F5B (warm taupe), secondary: #2DD4BF (soft teal for accents and CTAs), accent: #F59E0B (amber for badges and highlights). Backgrounds: #FFFFFF (white) alternating with #FDF8F0 (warm cream) and one dark #292524 (warm charcoal) section for contrast. Typography: Cormorant Garamond for headings (elegant serif), Inter for body text. Cards with 16px border-radius, minimal shadows, organic rounded shapes. Plenty of whitespace, natural textures (linen, warm wood tones in photos). Muted, earth-tone color palette throughout.

Responsive: On mobile, class type cards become horizontal swipe. Schedule collapses to accordion by time slot. Instructor cards become 2-column then single column. Pricing cards stack with "Most Popular" first. On-demand thumbnails become 2x2 grid. Location cards stack vertically. Floating "Book Class" button at bottom on mobile. Navigation collapses to hamburger with cream background overlay.
